```{r}
# Removing all saved variables
rm(list = ls())
```


```{r}
# Loading our data
heartdisease <- read.csv("heart_statlog_cleveland_hungary_final.csv")
heartdisease <- na.omit(heartdisease)
head(heartdisease)
```

```{r}
# Getting the number of rows of the data
nrow(heartdisease)
```

```{r}
# Creating a copy of the data
heartdisease.labelled <- heartdisease
```

## Values not possible to have

```{r}
# Number of observations with resting.bp.s = 0
nrow(heartdisease[heartdisease$resting.bp.s == 0, ])
```

```{r}
# Removing all entries with 0 blood pressure from
# both data frames
heartdisease <- heartdisease[heartdisease$resting.bp.s != 0,]
heartdisease.labelled <- heartdisease.labelled[heartdisease.labelled$resting.bp.s != 0,]
```

```{r}
# Number of observations with cholesterol = 0
nrow(heartdisease[heartdisease$cholesterol == 0, ])
```


```{r}
# Removing all rows with 0 cholesterol in both data frames
heartdisease <- heartdisease[heartdisease$cholesterol != 0,]
heartdisease.labelled <- heartdisease.labelled[heartdisease.labelled$cholesterol != 0,]
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

### Visualizing the data

```{r}
# Making a histogram for age
ggplot(heartdisease, aes(x = age)) + geom_histogram() + 
  labs(title = "Histogram of age", x = "Age (Years)")
```

```{r}
# Making a boxplot of age
ggplot(heartdisease, aes(x = age)) + geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(title = "Boxplot of age", x = "Age (Years)")
```


```{r}
# Summary statistics for age
print(paste0("Mean Age: ", round(mean(heartdisease$age), 3)))
print(paste0("SD Age: ", round(sd(heartdisease$age)), 3))
print(paste0("Median Age: ", median(heartdisease$age)))
print(paste0("IQR Age: ", quantile(heartdisease$age, 0.75) - quantile(heartdisease$age, 0.25)))
print(paste0("Min Age: ", min(heartdisease$age)))
print(paste0("Max Age: ", max(heartdisease$age)))
```

```{r}
# Labels for our age variable
heartdisease.labelled$age <- cut(heartdisease$age,
                                 breaks = c(seq(20, 80, 10)),
                                 labels = c("20s", "30s", "40s",
                                            "50s", "60s", "70s"))
```

```{r}
# Bar plot of labelled age
ggplot(heartdisease.labelled, aes(x = age)) + 
  geom_bar() + labs(title = "Bar plot of age", x = "Age")
```

```{r}
# Table of counts for new age variable
table(heartdisease.labelled$age)
```


```{r}

heartdisease.labelled$sex <- ifelse(heartdisease$sex == 1,
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Coding max hear rate column
heartdisease.labelled <- heartdisease.labelled %>%
  mutate(max.heart.rate = case_when(
    # Checking if max heart rate is below usual range
    max.heart.rate < 0.7*(220 - heartdisease$age) ~ "Low",
    # Checking if max heart rate is above usual range
    max.heart.rate > 0.85*(220 - heartdisease$age) ~ "High",
    # If max heart rate is in usual range
    TRUE ~ "Normal"
  )) 
```

```{r}
# Bar plot for max heart rate labels
ggplot(heartdisease.labelled, aes(x = max.heart.rate)) +
  geom_bar() + labs(title = "Bar plot of max heart rate", 
                    x = "Maximum heart rate")
```

```{r}
# Table of counts for new maximum heart rate variable
table(heartdisease.labelled$max.heart.rate)
```

```{r}
# Histogram for old peak
ggplot(heartdisease, aes(x = oldpeak)) + geom_histogram() +
   labs(title = "Histogram of old peak depression", x = "Old peak depression (mm)")
```

```{r}
# Boxplot for old peak
ggplot(heartdisease, aes(x = oldpeak)) + geom_boxplot() +
   labs(title = "Boxplot of old peak depression", 
        x = "Old peak depression (mm)")
```

```{r}
# Labelling the old peak depression variable
heartdisease.labelled <- heartdisease.labelled %>%
  mutate(oldpeak = case_when(
    # Checking if patient is in their 30s or 40s and old peak 
    #depression is in range
    (age == "20s" | age == "30s") & oldpeak <= 0.3 ~ "Normal",
    # Checking if patient is in their 30s or 40s and old peak 
    #depression is not in range
    (age == "20s" | age == "30s") & oldpeak > 0.3 ~ "High",
    # Checking if patient is in not in their 20s and 30s and 
    # old peak depression is in range
    (age != "20s" & age != "30s") & oldpeak <= 0.25 ~ "Normal",
    # Checking if patient is in not in their 20s and 30s and 
    # old peak depression is not in range
    TRUE ~ "High"
  ))
```


```{r}
# Bar plot for labelled old peak
ggplot(heartdisease.labelled, aes(x = oldpeak)) + geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Barplot of old peak depression",
       x = "Old peak depression")
```

```{r}
# Table of counts for new oldpeak variable
table(heartdisease.labelled$oldpeak)
```

```{r}
# Getting row with undefined label for ST slope
heartdisease[heartdisease$ST.slope == 0,]
```

```{r}
# Removing ST slope undefined value for both data frames
heartdisease <- heartdisease[heartdisease$ST.slope != 0,]
heartdisease.labelled <-
  heartdisease.labelled[heartdisease.labelled$ST.slope != 0,]
# Labels for ST slope
mappings.st <- c("1" = "Upsloping", "2" = "Flat", 
                 "3" = "Downsloping")
# Applying the labeling
heartdisease.labelled$ST.slope =
  mappings.st[as.character(heartdisease$ST.slope)]
# Bar plot for the labelled ST slope
ggplot(heartdisease.labelled, aes(ST.slope)) + geom_bar() +
   labs(title = "Bar plot for ST slope", x = "ST slope")
```

```{r}
# Table of counts for new ST slope variable
table(heartdisease.labelled$ST.slope)
```

```{r}
                                       "Heart disease", "Normal")
# Bar plot for the target variable
ggplot(heartdisease.labelled, aes(x = target)) + geom_bar() +
```

```{r}
# Outputting boxplot outlier bounds for resting blood
# pressure and cholesterol
print(paste0("Upper BP: ", quantile(heartdisease$resting.bp.s,
                                    0.75) + 1.5*(quantile(heartdisease$resting.bp.s, 0.75) -                                            quantile(heartdisease$resting.bp.s,
                          0.25))))
print(paste0("Upper Cholesterol: ", quantile(heartdisease$cholesterol, 0.75) +
               1.5*(quantile(heartdisease$cholesterol, 0.75) -
                      quantile(heartdisease$cholesterol, 0.25))))
```

```{r}
# Lablling entries as either possible outlier or not
heartdisease.labelled$outlier <- 
  ifelse(heartdisease$resting.bp.s > 170 |
           heartdisease$cholesterol > 9.73629 | heartdisease$resting.bp.s < 90 | heartdisease$oldpeak > 4, "Yes", "No")
```

```{r}
# Bar plot of possible outlier labels
ggplot(heartdisease.labelled, aes(x = outlier)) + geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Bar plot of whether a data point is a possible
       outlier", x = "Possible outlier")
```

```{r}
# Table of counts for outlier variable
table(heartdisease.labelled$outlier)
```

```{r}
# Number of rows left in final data set
```
